newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to unveil moderate budget growth.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to unveil moderate budget growth.

text.p: Indonesia is expected to announce a moderate expansion in its next national budget to sustain annual economic growth of just over 7 percent, economists said Sunday.
President Suharto will deliver Indonesia's 1997-1998 budget to parliament Monday.
Government sources said the budget would be based on an average oil price of $16.50 a barrel, unchanged from the current budget.

Indonesia, Asia's sole member of the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries, relied on oil and gas exports for about 16 percent of its 1996-1997 budget revenues, down from over 50 percent 10 years ago.
